sourceReviewClosures.finding: Read-only helper watchdog was initially installed after stdin consumption.
sourceReviewClosures.resolution: Fixed watchdog installed before stdin/read/import; actual bounded host child with stdin intentionally kept open exits2 under20ms test-only watchdog. This is a host process control, not a Docker/runtime/SQL test.

sourceReviewClosures.finding: Rejected fetch could bypass owned archive stream cleanup.
sourceReviewClosures.resolution: Entire fetch/read/parse path is wrapped in finally; synthetic rejecting-fetch control verifies destruction.

sourceReviewClosures.finding: Self-review concurrent resume could read stale history before acquiring its run lock.
sourceReviewClosures.resolution: Owned exclusive lock acquired before history scan. Actual tiny synthetic file control inserts the prior uncertain-upload event at that boundary and proves resume refuses a fresh upload.

sourceReviewClosures.finding: Ready verification needed complete report/resource joins.
sourceReviewClosures.resolution: All six server verification checks, full manifest resource list, every verified resource SHA and normal storage-readback totals are compared before selection.

privacy.syntheticJournalControl: Fresh tiny ignored scratch files only; no recursive cleanup or denied-directory retry.

limitations: Parent is sole actual executor after independent source review.

Unit controls exercise the authority/workflow contracts, mock HTTP, an actual host watchdog and a tiny synthetic journal. They do not replace actual protected import, row/bucket preservation, UI or engineering acceptance checks.
Public filename numeric suffixes are labels; actual filesystem run timestamps are retained above.
A hard crash can leave an owned run lock; no automatic stale-lock bypass or replacement idempotency key is implemented.
Uncertain accepted operations are retained and require later same-directory reconciliation; no upload or PATCH auto-retry.
